title: Node and sign certificates restated for the limit of the named constructions; a finite-box sign corollary for the padded family; updated obligations
selection_reason: BB2 admits that the reduced densities of F1 and F2 converge as whole sequences to one common limit that coincides with every AQ1 and every F2 subsequential limit. The Round32 node certificate (AV2) and sign certificate (AW2) were stated for each AQ1 subsequential state separately; with the identification they become statements about one state, the limit of the named constructions, with unchanged constants. The whole-sequence rate also turns the AW2 enclosure into a sign certificate for the padded boxes from an explicit size on. The obligations table of AY2 is updated with the Round33 gates.
model: Zero-selected patterned family (AM2/AQ1, model AQ_patterned_zero_selected) at tau=+10^-8, with tau=-10^-8 as a replay of the same |tau| formula at the mirrored coupling; the limit of the named constructions omega_inf (the common whole-sequence limit of F1 = AQ1 centered whole-star boxes and F2 = I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding on Lambda_N, admitted in BB2) and the finite-box ground states omega^{F,N} of F1 and F2, N at least 2, untruncated at fixed N; the original xz Wilson loop W with cover R={0,e_z}; Euclidean clock s=alpha t_E/hbar with G=H/alpha; the centered Euclidean Wilson correlation C(s)=(chi, e^{-sG} chi) with chi=(pi(W)-omega_inf(W))Omega in the GNS representation of omega_inf; the static equal-time Wilson mean omega(W).

parameters.metric: trace norm on B(H_R) for states (the BB1/BB2 coarse l-infinity metric for the inherited bounds); operator norm with ||W|| at most 1
parameters.weights: not applicable: no new decay estimate; the BB2 whole-sequence bound is inherited at its gate bound value
parameters.window: the AV2 C^2 window g at s=1, unchanged (M_0=2, M_1=4s/pi), read from the AV2 gate
parameters.clock: s=alpha t_E/hbar at the single preregistered node s=1; theta=alpha t/hbar for the inherited dynamics
parameters.av2_certificate: the AV2 gate exact datum d and radius bound R and the resulting interval, read from the hash-verified AV2 gate, restated unchanged for omega_inf
parameters.aw2_certificate: the AW2 gate enclosure of omega_tau(W) at tau=+10^-8 and its mirror at tau=-10^-8, read from the hash-verified AW2 gate, restated unchanged for omega_inf
parameters.finite_box_sign: for F2 boxes: |omega^{F2,N}(W)-omega_inf(W)| <= ||W|| ||rho^{F2,N}_R-rho^inf_R||_1 <= C' q^(N-1) with q=1/64 and C' the BB2 gate bound value; hence omega^{F2,N}(W) lies in the AW2 enclosure widened by C' q^(N-1) on both sides, and its sign is certified for every N at least N_sign, the least N at least 2 with C' q^(N-1) < tau/144-K_2^+ tau^2 at tau=10^-8, computed exactly; for F1 boxes the AW2 gate already certifies every N at least 2 at every cutoff (recorded as agreement, not re-derived)
parameters.common_gns_item: the F1 and F2 limits are one state (BB2 items 2-3) with one GNS triple; its GNS dynamics is the AQ1 limit dynamics T_theta implemented in that representation (BA2 for F2, AQ1 for F1); correlation functions on |theta| at most 8 are the limits of the finite-box correlation functions of either family (BB2 item 5)
parameters.obligations: AY2 rows O1-O6 with their status after BA1, BA2, BB1, BB2, plus every new open row recorded by the Round33 gates (at least: states outside the named constructions and other boundary conditions; the finite-box Euclidean node for F2 boxes and for finite F1 boxes; the correlation rate beyond N=14000 with the frozen r_N; GNS dynamics of different states; uniform in time; the route-B uniform model (BC2); anything uniform in the lattice spacing a; the continuum problem)

required: 1. Using BB2 items 2-3 as admitted (the F1 and F2 limits coincide on every finite region and equal every AQ1 and every F2 subsequential limit), restate the AV2 node certificate for the limit of the named constructions omega_inf at s=1 with the AV2 datum d, radius bound R and interval unchanged (read exactly from the AV2 gate), at tau=+10^-8, and the tau=-10^-8 value as a replay of the same |tau| formula; keep the free reference inside the interval (reference_unresolved) and claim no interaction shift.

2. Restate the AW2 enclosure of the static Wilson mean for omega_inf at tau=+10^-8 and its mirror at tau=-10^-8 with the endpoints unchanged (read exactly from the AW2 gate), keeping the full second-order remainder K_2^+ tau^2.

3. Prove the finite-box sign corollary for the padded family: for every N at least 2, omega^{F2,N}(W) lies in the AW2 enclosure widened by C' q^(N-1) on both sides, with C' the BB2 gate bound value and q=1/64; compute N_sign exactly and certify the sign of omega^{F2,N}(W) at both signs of tau for every N at least N_sign; record the F1 boxes as already certified by AW2 at every N at least 2; state the rate q^(N-1) with its range.

4. Finite-box node: determine from the AV2 reports and gate (research/round32/forward/av2/report.md, research/round32/reverse/av2/report.md, research/round32/advisor/av2-gate.json) whether the AV2 certificate was proved box by box for the finite centered whole-star boxes before the passage to AQ1 limits (the window lemma needs only L^1 inversion, Fubini and nonnegativity of the generator; the slope k holds uniformly in the box; D is volume-uniform). If the admitted record proves the finite-box step, restate the certificate for every finite F1 box N at least 2 at the unchanged radius, citing the exact places; otherwise, and in any case for finite F2 boxes (whose incidence and slope are not in the AV2 record), keep an open obligation row with the missing premise. Never re-derive or retune a constant.

5. State the common GNS item: the F1 and F2 limits are one state with one GNS triple and one GNS dynamics (the AQ1 limit dynamics T_theta), with correlation functions on |theta| at most 8 given by BB2 item 5 and its rate only on its certified range; this is not equality of GNS dynamics of different states.

6. Write the updated obligations table: every AY2 row O1-O6 with its status (closed within a named scope with the closing gate, or open) and every new open row, each with the missing premise and a candidate route; state which Round32 limitations the Round33 gates lift and which remain.

7. Quote the mandatory sentence template once as one unbroken span; export the gate fields; implement every control as a damaging mutation in an exact checker (standard library, Fractions, byte-identical under -B and -B -O).
claim_exclusions: uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state
an interaction shift, sign or coefficient of the Euclidean correlation C(s)
equality of GNS dynamics of different states
any estimate uniform in the lattice spacing a
direction_note: Statement loop: one forward producer restates admitted certificates with unchanged constants, proves the finite-box corollary by exact arithmetic from admitted constants, and writes the obligations table; the skeptic replays the restatement and the corollary from the contract and the gates alone.

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: The restated datum, radius, interval and enclosure endpoints equal the AV2/AW2 gate values exactly; the identification rests on BB2 items 2-3 as admitted; N_sign is computed exactly from the BB2 gate bound value and the AW2 constants and the F2 finite-box sign is certified at both signs for every N at least N_sign; the common GNS item is stated with its scope; the obligations table is complete; every rate claim carries its range.
acceptance.limited: Items 1-2 are restated but the finite-box corollary or the common GNS item is omitted, or the obligations table is incomplete; each omission recorded with its reason.
acceptance.insufficient: The identification premise is not admitted as used, or a restated constant differs from its gate value; the Round32 certificates then stand only as stated there.

new_control_semantics.certificate_values_unchanged: The restated AV2 datum d, radius bound R and interval, and the AW2 enclosure endpoints at both signs, are read from the hash-verified Round32 gates and must equal them exactly as rationals; a restated radius, datum or endpoint that differs from the gate value (smaller, larger or re-rounded) is rejected, and no constant of the certificates is re-derived or retuned.
new_control_semantics.post_hoc_node_rejected: Only the preregistered node s=1 is restated; any other node, a grid, or a crossover value presented as a node certificate is rejected.
new_control_semantics.finite_box_sign_from_whole_sequence: The finite-box sign statement for F2 boxes uses the BB2 whole-sequence bound ||rho^{F,N}_R-rho^inf_R||_1 <= C' q^(N-1) (the limit M to infinity of the sup over M greater than N) at the BB2 gate bound value, with ||W|| at most 1; a bound from a subsequence, from an N to N+1 comparison alone, or from the BB1 per-comparison constant without the whole-sequence passage is rejected; N_sign is the least N at least 2 with C' q^(N-1) strictly below tau/144-K_2^+ tau^2, computed exactly.
new_control_semantics.mirror_sign_replay_not_confirmation: (R32) The tau=-10^-8 statements replay the same |tau| formula at the mirrored coupling and are never counted as a second confirmation.
new_control_semantics.reference_unresolved_retained: The AV2 free reference e^{-3}/4 lies inside the restated interval; the restatement keeps the sub-label reference_unresolved and claims no interaction shift, sign or coefficient of C(s); presenting the restated node as resolving the reference is rejected.
new_control_semantics.obligations_table_complete: The updated obligations table carries every AY2 row O1-O6 with its status after BA1-BB2 (closed within a named scope, or open) and every new open row the Round33 gates record, each with the missing premise and a candidate route; a closed row without the gate that closes it and its scope, or a dropped row, is rejected.
new_control_semantics.rate_range_stated: Every rate claim carries its certified range of N (the BB2 item-5 rate holds only on 5<=N<=14000; the density rate q^(N-1) for every N at least 2); an unqualified O(1/N) statement is rejected.
new_control_semantics.round32_gates_untouched: No Round32 gate, report or snapshot is edited; the restatement is a new Round33 record that cites them by hash.
new_control_semantics.route_b_not_restated: The AX2 route-B certificate is not restated in BC1 (the route-B limit is BC2's subject); applying the AV2 or AW2 restatement to the uniform model is rejected.
new_control_semantics.same_state_not_different_states: The common GNS representation and dynamics of the F1 and F2 limits is stated only because BB2 admits that the two limits are one state and BA2 that the F2 limit dynamics is the AQ1 limit dynamics T_theta; it is never phrased as equality of GNS dynamics of different states, and gns_dynamics_equality_claimed stays false.
new_control_semantics.finite_box_node_only_from_record: A finite-box node certificate is restated only where the admitted AV2 record proves the finite-box step (cited by file and section); a finite-box node for F2 boxes, or one obtained by re-deriving the AV2 constants, is rejected as a restatement and belongs to an open obligation row.
new_control_semantics.second_order_remainder_kept: The AW2 enclosure keeps the full second-order remainder K_2^+ tau^2 at both endpoints and the finite-box statement adds C' q^(N-1) on both sides; dropping either term is rejected.

any estimate uniform in the lattice spacing a
preregistration.state_provenance: the limit of the named constructions omega_inf (BB2: the common whole-sequence limit of F1 and F2, equal to every AQ1 and F2 subsequential limit) and the untruncated finite-box ground states of F1 and F2 at fixed N

target.note: feasibility/format check, not a blind discriminating threshold: the restated values are admitted gate values and N_sign follows from admitted constants by exact arithmetic; the obligations table must also be complete

preregistration.mandatory_sentence_template: For the zero-selected patterned family at tau=10^-8, the limit of the named construction families F1 and F2 admitted in BB2 satisfies the Round32 node certificate at s=1 with the unchanged datum and radius and the Round32 enclosure of the static Wilson mean with the unchanged endpoints, and every padded box Lambda_N with N at least the exactly computed N_sign has a static Wilson mean of certified sign; these are restatements of admitted certificates for one limit of the named constructions and a finite-box corollary, not uniqueness of any ground state, not an interaction shift of the Euclidean correlation, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a.

gate_fields_required.finite_box_sign_scope: F2 boxes Lambda_N with N at least N_sign, both signs of tau, through the BB2 whole-sequence bound; F1 boxes as certified by AW2

preregistration.gate_fields_rule: the gate_fields_required values hold for accepted_within_scope; a limited verdict exports the field of each omitted item false with its reason
forbidden_phrasings: uniqueness of the infinite-volume ground state

scaling_brackets_per_constant.N_sign: not applicable (an integer computed at tau=10^-8); the widened enclosure half-width K_2^+ tau^2 + C' q^(N-1) is reported at tau and tau/100 for information only
